# sigma_deployment_policies (Data Source)

Lists Sigma deployment policies. This resource uses a Sigma Beta API and may change without notice.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_deployment_policies" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `deployment_policies` (Attributes List) Deployment policies visible to the caller. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployment_policies))
- `id` (String) Stable identifier for this data source.

<a id="nestedatt--deployment_policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployment_policies`

Read-Only:

- `copy_input_table_data` (Boolean) Whether input table data is copied when deploying.
- `id` (String) Deployment policy ID.
- `name` (String) Deployment policy name.
- `name_in_tenant` (String) Workspace name created in receiving tenants.
- `source_swap_policies` (Set of String) Source swap policy IDs used when deploying documents.
- `version_tag_id` (String) Version tag ID.
